items.item_title: Can we pay by invoice instead of card?
My country or currency isn't listed. What now?
Do benefits stack as we move up tiers?
Who do I talk to before committing?

settings.editor: Yes. Email membership@mautic.org and we'll issue an invoice so you can pay in advance by bank transfer.

Pricing is tiered by country (loosely based on the Big Mac Index) so membership is affordable worldwide. To qualify for Tier 2 or Tier 3 pricing you'll need to provide evidence that your company's headquarters is in the selected country — for example company formation certificates supported by bank account information.
Some currencies can't be displayed due to Stripe limitations. If you don't see your country or expected currency, email membership@mautic.org and we'll sort it out directly.
Benefits of the same type are replaced rather than compounded. If Bronze includes 1 forum ad campaign and Silver includes 2, Silver members get 2 (not 3).

Individuals join for $100/year, pro-rated based on your country. You get a vote in the General Assembly, can stand in Council and leadership elections, and directly shape governance. Regular contributors may also qualify for the free participatory route.
A human, gladly: membership@mautic.org. We usually reply within a day.
